visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up shot of a human hand holding an intricate, cherry blossom-shaped paper cut-out known as a Goshuin. The paper is pink and white with delicate flower patterns and traditional Japanese calligraphy and red seal stamps. In the background, a blurred temple structure and a clear blue sky suggest an outdoor sacred setting during a bright spring day. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of a 'chozuya' water basin. A detailed dark grey dragon statue spouts a thin stream of water into a stone basin filled with a lush arrangement of pink and red flowers. A wooden water ladle is partially visible on the right side. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the statue and the petals. (3) The camera shows a vertical display of multiple paper-cut Goshuin designs, each in a clear plastic sleeve. The designs vary in color and theme, featuring wisteria, sunflowers, and other seasonal flowers. Large, white text overlays with red borders appear at the bottom, providing information about the variety and pricing of these items. (4) The final shot focuses on a tall, rectangular stone pillar at the entrance of the temple, with '萬年山 法輪寺' deeply engraved in black characters. The background features stone steps leading upwards into the temple grounds, flanked by lush green trees and traditional architecture under the midday sun.
